facts.text: I am designing an online course about forklift safety for workers in a fish factory.
I have a speed sensor installed on the factory forklift.
The speed sensor sends velocity data to our Learning Record Store at doughahn.net/LRS.
I want three xAPI statements for when the forklift is in motion, stopped, and going over 5 miles an hour.
I asked to regenerate the third response because it looked clipped.
